Rules.InvariantScript:
"
Reset Password
"

If(
    locPasswordError,
    Color.Red,
    If(
        locPasswordError = false And gblPasswordsDontMatch,
        Color.Red,
        RGBA(
            0,
            0,
            139,
            1
        )
    )
)

//If(locPasswordError, Color.Red, RGBA(219, 219, 219, 1))
If(
    locPasswordError,
    Color.Red,
    If(
        gblBlankEntry And locPasswordError = false And IsBlank(txtNewPassword.Text),
        Color.Red,
        RGBA(
            219,
            219,
            219,
            1
        )
    )
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    locPasswordError,
    Color.Red,
    If(
        locPasswordError = false And gblPasswordsDontMatch,
        Color.Red,
        RGBA(
            99,
            139,
            44,
            1
        )
    )
)
